exercises.title: Apps 1 — DNS, HTTP, DHCP concepts
exercises.problemHtml:
Core application-layer protocols.

This set has 5 questions. There is nothing to run: answer in the panel on the right and press Submit. The questions follow the style of the NWC204 final exam, so work them out on paper first, exactly as you would in the exam hall.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Apps 1 — DNS, HTTP, DHCP concepts — answer key

1. A DNS “A” record maps a name to …Bản ghi DNS “A” ánh xạ tên sang …
   Answer: d) an IPv4 address
   AAAA = IPv6, MX = mail, CNAME = alias, NS = name server, PTR = reverse.VI: AAAA = IPv6, MX = mail, CNAME = bí danh, NS = máy chủ tên, PTR = ngược.

2. DNS normally uses …DNS thường dùng …
   Answer: c) UDP port 53 (TCP for big answers)
   Short queries fit in one UDP datagram.VI: Truy vấn ngắn vừa trong một datagram UDP.

3. HTTP status code 404 means …Mã trạng thái HTTP 404 nghĩa là …
   Answer: a) the resource was not found
   5xx = server errors, 4xx = client errors, 3xx = redirects, 2xx = success.VI: 5xx = lỗi server, 4xx = lỗi client, 3xx = chuyển hướng, 2xx = thành công.

4. The four DHCP messages are …Bốn thông điệp DHCP là …
   Answer: a) Discover, Offer, Request, Acknowledge
   “DORA”. Discover and Request are broadcasts.VI: “DORA”. Discover và Request là broadcast.

5. A DHCP lease gives a client …Một lease DHCP cấp cho client …
   Answer: c) IP address, mask, gateway and DNS server for a limited time
   The client renews at 50% of the lease time.VI: Client gia hạn ở 50% thời gian lease.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Answer key / Đáp án

  1. d) an IPv4 address

    AAAA = IPv6, MX = mail, CNAME = alias, NS = name server, PTR = reverse.

    VI: AAAA = IPv6, MX = mail, CNAME = bí danh, NS = máy chủ tên, PTR = ngược.

  2. c) UDP port 53 (TCP for big answers)

    Short queries fit in one UDP datagram.

    VI: Truy vấn ngắn vừa trong một datagram UDP.

  3. a) the resource was not found

    5xx = server errors, 4xx = client errors, 3xx = redirects, 2xx = success.

    VI: 5xx = lỗi server, 4xx = lỗi client, 3xx = chuyển hướng, 2xx = thành công.

  4. a) Discover, Offer, Request, Acknowledge

    “DORA”. Discover and Request are broadcasts.

    VI: “DORA”. Discover và Request là broadcast.

  5. c) IP address, mask, gateway and DNS server for a limited time

    The client renews at 50% of the lease time.

    VI: Client gia hạn ở 50% thời gian lease.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Apps 2 — Order DNS and DHCP exchanges — answer key

1. Recursive DNS lookup of www.example.com (empty caches)Tra DNS đệ quy www.example.com (cache rỗng)
   Answer: m2) The client asks its recursive resolver  →  m1) The resolver asks a root server and gets the .com name servers  →  m5) The resolver asks a .com TLD server and gets example.com’s name servers  →  m4) The resolver asks the example.com authoritative server and gets the A record  →  m3) The resolver caches the answer and returns it to the client
   Root → TLD → authoritative; the resolver does the legwork and caches.VI: Root → TLD → authoritative; resolver làm việc nặng và lưu cache.

2. DHCPDHCP
   Answer: m3) Client broadcasts DHCPDISCOVER  →  m1) Server unicasts/broadcasts DHCPOFFER  →  m4) Client broadcasts DHCPREQUEST for the offered address  →  m2) Server sends DHCPACK confirming the lease
   D-O-R-A.VI: D-O-R-A.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Root → TLD → authoritative; the resolver does the legwork and caches.

VI: Root → TLD → authoritative; resolver làm việc nặng và lưu cache.

D-O-R-A.

VI: D-O-R-A.
